### 0	distinct union
SELECT
`x__5` AS `x`,  
`x__5` AS `y`
FROM (
WITH `toks` AS 	(  
SELECT    
true AS `x__1`,      
1 AS `y__2`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs8`.`x__1` AS `x__5`  
FROM `toks` AS `wrs8`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs8`.`x__1`)
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 1	with scan union all

### 3	having with union all
SELECT
`total_rows__7` AS `total_rows`
FROM (
WITH `toks` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `x__1`  )
,   
`toks2` AS 	(  
SELECT    
2 AS `x__4`  )
  
SELECT  
`total_rows__3` AS `total_rows__7`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_count(`wrs13`.`x__1`) AS `total_rows__3`    
FROM `toks` AS `wrs13`    
WHERE `wrs13`.`x__1` > 0
) AS `aggregate_scan_11`  
WHERE `total_rows__3` >= 0  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`total_rows__6` AS `total_rows__7`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_count(`wrs23`.`x__4`) AS `total_rows__6`    
FROM `toks2` AS `wrs23`    
WHERE `wrs23`.`x__4` > 0
) AS `aggregate_scan_21`  
WHERE `total_rows__6` >= 0
) AS `set_op_scan_3`;

### 36	recursive cte
SELECT
`iteration__7` AS `iteration`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `CTE_1` AS 	(  
SELECT    
`iteration__3` AS `iteration__4`    
FROM (
SELECT      
1 AS `iteration__3`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
1 AS `iteration__3`
) AS `set_op_scan_7`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
zetasqlite_add(`rrs17`.`iteration__4`, 1) AS `iteration__4`    
FROM `CTE_1` AS `rrs17`    
WHERE `rrs17`.`iteration__4` < 3  )
  
SELECT  
`iteration__7`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs19`.`iteration__4` AS `iteration__7`    
FROM `CTE_1` AS `wrs19`
) AS `with_ref_scan_19`  
ORDER BY `iteration__7` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 37	recursive cte 2
SELECT
`node__25` AS `node`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `GraphData` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `from_node__17`,      
2 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
1 AS `from_node__17`,      
3 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
2 AS `from_node__17`,      
3 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
3 AS `from_node__17`,      
4 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
5 AS `from_node__17`,      
6 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
5 AS `from_node__17`,      
7 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
6 AS `from_node__17`,      
8 AS `to_node__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
7 AS `from_node__17`,      
8 AS `to_node__18`  )
,   
`R` AS 	(  
SELECT    
5 AS `node__20`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
`with_ref_scan_39`.`to_node__18` AS `node__20`    
FROM `R` AS `recursive_ref_scan_38` INNER JOIN `GraphData` AS `with_ref_scan_39` ON `recursive_ref_scan_38`.`node__20` = `with_ref_scan_39`.`from_node__17`  )
  
SELECT  
`node__25`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs42`.`node__20` AS `node__25`    
FROM `R` AS `wrs42`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs42`.`node__20`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_41`  
ORDER BY `node__25` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 42	recursive cte 7

,

### 43	recursive cte integration

FROM `CTE_3` AS `wrs52`    
WHERE zetasqlite_greater(`wrs52`.`iteration__71`, zetasqlite_multiply(500, 2))
) AS `set_op_scan_41` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__111`,      
`type` AS `type__112`,      
`length_m` AS `length_m__113`,      
`upline_parent` AS `upline_parent__114`,      
`upline_feeder` AS `upline_feeder__115`    
FROM `grid_interior_resources` AS `b`
) AS `table_scan_53` ON `upline_parent__107` = `id__111`
) AS `with_scan_3`;
SELECT
`id__1` AS `id`,  
`type__2` AS `type`,  
`upline_resource_id__3` AS `upline_resource_id`,  
`upline_resource_type__4` AS `upline_resource_type`,  
`upline_resource_hops__5` AS `upline_resource_hops`,  
`upline_resource_distance__6` AS `upline_resource_distance`
FROM (
SELECT  
`id__1`,    
`type__2`,    
`upline_resource_id__3`,    
`upline_resource_type__4`,    
`upline_resource_hops__5`,    
`upline_resource_distance__6`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`type` AS `type__2`,      
`upline_resource_id` AS `upline_resource_id__3`,      
`upline_resource_type` AS `upline_resource_type__4`,      
`upline_resource_hops` AS `upline_resource_hops__5`,      
`upline_resource_distance` AS `upline_resource_distance__6`    
FROM `ancestry`
) AS `table_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `id__1` ASC, `upline_resource_hops__5` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `grid_interior_resources`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `ancestry`;

### 44	recursive cte integration 2
CREATE TABLE `numbers` (`num` INT) ;
INSERT INTO `numbers`
 (`num`) 
 SELECT
`num__6` AS `num`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `seq` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `num__3`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
zetasqlite_add(`rrs12`.`num__3`, 1) AS `num__3`    
FROM `seq` AS `rrs12`    
WHERE `rrs12`.`num__3` < 5  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs14`.`num__3` AS `num__6`  
FROM `seq` AS `wrs14`
) AS `with_scan_3`;
SELECT
`num`
FROM `numbers`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `numbers`;

### 111	any_value with having max
SELECT
`fruit__18` AS `fruit`,  
`max_sales__17` AS `max_sales`
FROM (
WITH `Store` AS 	(  
SELECT    
20 AS `sold__13`,      
X'606170706c6573' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__13`,      
X'606170706c6573' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
40 AS `sold__13`,      
X'607065617273' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__13`,      
X'606f72616e676573' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
30 AS `sold__13`,      
X'6062616e616e6173' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__13`,      
X'6062616e616e6173' AS `fruit__14`  )
  
SELECT  
`fruit__18`,    
`max_sales__17`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs26`.`fruit__14` AS `fruit__18`,      
zetasqlite_any_value(`wrs26`.`sold__13`, zetasqlite_having_max(`wrs26`.`sold__13`)) AS `max_sales__17`    
FROM `Store` AS `wrs26`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs26`.`fruit__14`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_25`  
ORDER BY `fruit__18` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

null AS `$col1`;

### 195	window total
WITH `Produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'606b616c65' AS `item__19`,    
23 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6062616e616e61' AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'606672756974' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6063616262616765' AS `item__19`,    
9 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606170706c65' AS `item__19`,    
8 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'606672756974' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606c65656b' AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606c657474756365' AS `item__19`,    
10 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`)

SELECT
`item__22` AS `item`,  
`purchases__23` AS `purchases`,  
`category__24` AS `category`,  
`total_purchases__26` AS `total_purchases`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__22`,    
`purchases__23`,    
`category__24`,    
zetasqlite_window_sum(`purchases__23`) OVER (ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `total_purchases__26`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs26`.`item__19` AS `item__22`,      
`wrs26`.`purchases__20` AS `purchases__23`,      
`wrs26`.`category__21` AS `category__24`    
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs26`
) AS `with_ref_scan_26`
) AS `analytic_scan_25`;

### 205	nth_value
SELECT
`name__34` AS `name`,  
`finish_time__44` AS `finish_time`,  
`division__36` AS `division`,  
`fastest_time__45` AS `fastest_time`,  
`second_fastest__46` AS `second_fastest`
FROM (
WITH `finishers` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'60536f70686961204c6975' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1ac5df5240' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604c697361205374656c7a6e6572' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1ace931ac0' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604e696b6b69204c65697468' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1adfdc2740' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604c617572656e204d61747468657773' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1ae7f75940' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'6044657369726565204265727279' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1af7c2ed80' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'6053757a7920536c616e65' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1afa43cc00' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604a656e2045647761726473' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1afafae700' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604d656768616e204c656465726572' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1afedab940' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604361726c7920466f727465' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1b0371a680' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604632352d3239' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604c617572656e20526561736f6e6572' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1b07f95180' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__33`  )
  
SELECT  
`name__34`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'602558', `finish_time__35`) AS `finish_time__44`,    
`division__36`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'602558', `fastest_time__42`) AS `fastest_time__45`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'602558', `second_fastest__43`) AS `second_fastest__46`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`name__34`,      
`finish_time__35`,      
`division__36`,      
`finishers__41`,      
zetasqlite_window_first_value(`finish_time__35`) OVER (PARTITION BY `division__36` ORDER BY `finish_time__35` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `fastest_time__42`,      
zetasqlite_window_nth_value(`finish_time__35`, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY `division__36` ORDER BY `finish_time__35` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `second_fastest__43`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`wrs40`.`name__31` AS `name__34`,        
`wrs40`.`finish_time__32` AS `finish_time__35`,        
`wrs40`.`division__33` AS `division__36`,        
zetasqlite_make_struct(X'606e616d65', `wrs40`.`name__31`, X'6066696e6973685f74696d65', `wrs40`.`finish_time__32`, X'606469766973696f6e', `wrs40`.`division__33`) AS `finishers__41`      
FROM `finishers` AS `wrs40`
) AS `project_scan_39`    
ORDER BY `division__36` ASC, `finish_time__35` ASC, `division__36` ASC, `finish_time__35` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_38`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 206	lead
WITH `finishers` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'60536f70686961204c6975' AS `name__31`,    
X'5880053f1ac5df5240' AS `finish_time__32`,

UNION ALL  
SELECT

### 209	window order by

X'6063' AS `letter__10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'408000000000004d2a' AS `dt__9`,    
X'6062' AS `letter__10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'408000000000004d2a' AS `dt__9`,    
X'6063' AS `letter__10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'408000000000004d47' AS `dt__9`,    
X'6061' AS `letter__10`)

SELECT
`dt__11` AS `dt`,  
`letter__12` AS `letter`,  
`rn__14` AS `rn`
FROM (
SELECT  
`dt__11`,    
`letter__12`,    
zetasqlite_window_row_number() OVER (ORDER BY `dt__11` ASC, `letter__12` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `rn__14`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs20`.`dt__9` AS `dt__11`,      
`wrs20`.`letter__10` AS `letter__12`    
FROM `toks` AS `wrs20`
) AS `with_ref_scan_20`  
ORDER BY `dt__11` ASC, `letter__12` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_19`;

zetasqlite_window_percentile_disc(`x__1`, 0.0, zetasqlite_ignore_nulls()) OVER (ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `min__3`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`$array_5`.`value` AS `x__1`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e0404016300040162040161') AS `$array_5`
) AS `array_scan_5`
) AS `analytic_scan_4`;

### 215	percentile_disc
SELECT
`x__1` AS `x`,  
`min__5` AS `min`,  
`median__6` AS `median`,  
`max__7` AS `max`
FROM (
SELECT  
`x__1`,    
zetasqlite_window_percentile_disc(`x__1`, 0.0, zetasqlite_ignore_nulls()) OVER (ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `min__5`,    
zetasqlite_window_percentile_disc(`x__1`, 0.5, zetasqlite_ignore_nulls()) OVER (ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `median__6`,    
zetasqlite_window_percentile_disc(`x__1`, 1.0, zetasqlite_ignore_nulls()) OVER (ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `max__7`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`$array_5`.`value` AS `x__1`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e0404016300040162040161') AS `$array_5`
) AS `array_scan_5`
) AS `analytic_scan_4`;

10 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL

### 230	row_number nest
WITH `Produce` AS 	(

X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`)
, 
`Numbers` AS 	(
SELECT  
`item__22`,    
`purchases__23`,    
`category__24`,    
`num__26`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`item__22`,      
`purchases__23`,      
`category__24`,      
zetasqlite_window_row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY `category__24` ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `num__26`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`wrs27`.`item__19` AS `item__22`,        
`wrs27`.`purchases__20` AS `purchases__23`,        
`wrs27`.`category__21` AS `category__24`      
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs27`
) AS `with_ref_scan_27`    
ORDER BY `category__24` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_26`)

SELECT
`item__27` AS `item`,  
`category__29` AS `category`,  
`purchases__28` AS `purchases`,  
`num__33` AS `num`,  
`num2__35` AS `num2`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__27`,    
`purchases__28`,    
`category__29`,    
`item__30`,    
`purchases__31`,    
`category__32`,    
`num__33`,    
zetasqlite_window_row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY `category__29` ORDER BY `purchases__28` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `num2__35`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`item__27`,      
`purchases__28`,      
`category__29`,      
`item__30`,      
`purchases__31`,      
`category__32`,      
`num__33`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`wrs31`.`item__19` AS `item__27`,        
`wrs31`.`purchases__20` AS `purchases__28`,        
`wrs31`.`category__21` AS `category__29`      
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs31`
) AS `with_ref_scan_31` INNER JOIN (
SELECT      
`wrs32`.`item__22` AS `item__30`,        
`wrs32`.`purchases__23` AS `purchases__31`,        
`wrs32`.`category__24` AS `category__32`,        
`wrs32`.`num__26` AS `num__33`      
FROM `Numbers` AS `wrs32`
) AS `with_ref_scan_32` ON `item__27` = `item__30` AND `category__29` = `category__32`
) AS `join_scan_30`  
ORDER BY `category__29` ASC, `purchases__28` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_29`;

`item__10`,    
`kind__11`,    
`purchases__12`  
FROM (
SELECT    
X'6062616e616e61' AS `item__10`,      
X'606672756974' AS `kind__11`,      
2 AS `purchases__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'606f6e696f6e' AS `item__10`,      
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `kind__11`,

UNION ALL

X'606f72616e6765' AS `item__10`,      
X'606672756974' AS `kind__11`,      
4 AS `purchases__12`
) AS `set_op_scan_6`  
ORDER BY `item__10` ASC)

SELECT
`item__13` AS `item`,  
`purchases__15` AS `purchases`,  
`next_in_kind__18` AS `next_in_kind`,  
`next_best_seller__19` AS `next_best_seller`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__13`,    
`kind__14`,    
`purchases__15`,    
zetasqlite_window_lead(`item__13`) OVER (PARTITION BY `kind__14` ORDER BY `item__13` ASC ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `next_in_kind__18`,    
zetasqlite_window_lag(`item__13`) OVER (ORDER BY `purchases__15` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `next_best_seller__19`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs18`.`item__10` AS `item__13`,      
`wrs18`.`kind__11` AS `kind__14`,      
`wrs18`.`purchases__12` AS `purchases__15`    
FROM `inventory` AS `wrs18`
) AS `with_ref_scan_18`  
ORDER BY `kind__14` ASC, `item__13` ASC, `purchases__15` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_17`;

`wrs14`.`rank__6` AS `rank__8`

) AS `with_ref_scan_14`  
ORDER BY `created_at__7` ASC, `rank__8` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_13`;

### 283	array length comparison
SELECT
`idx__10` AS `idx`,  
`col1__11` AS `col1`,  
`arr_col__12` AS `arr_col`
FROM (
SELECT  
1 AS `idx__10`,    
1 AS `col1__11`,    
X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000' AS `arr_col__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
2 AS `idx__10`,    
2 AS `col1__11`,    
X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000' AS `arr_col__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
3 AS `idx__10`,    
3 AS `col1__11`,    
X'0e04010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000010400000000000000' AS `arr_col__12`
) AS `set_op_scan_6` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT  
1 AS `idx__22`,    
1 AS `col1__23`,    
X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000' AS `arr_col__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
3 AS `idx__22`,    
3 AS `col1__23`,    
X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000' AS `arr_col__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
4 AS `idx__22`,    
4 AS `col1__23`,    
X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000' AS `arr_col__24`
) AS `set_op_scan_16` ON `idx__10` = `idx__22`
WHERE zetasqlite_not_equal(zetasqlite_array_length(`arr_col__12`), zetasqlite_array_length(`arr_col__24`));

### 311	null array scan
SELECT
`id__7` AS `id`,  
`write_mode__12` AS `write_mode`,  
`read_mode__13` AS `read_mode`
FROM (
WITH `file` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `file_id__5`,      
X'0e02040172040177' AS `modes__6`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
2 AS `file_id__5`,      
X'0e01040177' AS `modes__6`  )
  
SELECT  
`id__7`,    
zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null((SELECT    
`$array_18`.`value` AS `mode__10`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(`modes__9`) AS `$array_18`    
WHERE `$array_18`.`value` = X'6077'))) AS `write_mode__12`,    
zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null((SELECT    
`$array_21`.`value` AS `mode__11`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(`modes__9`) AS `$array_21`    
WHERE `$array_21`.`value` = X'6072'))) AS `read_mode__13`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`$array_14`.`value` AS `id__7`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_14`
) AS `array_scan_14` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`wrs15`.`file_id__5` AS `file_id__8`,      
`wrs15`.`modes__6` AS `modes__9`    
FROM `file` AS `wrs15`
) AS `with_ref_scan_15` ON `file_id__8` = `id__7`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 314	group by
WITH `Sales` AS 	(
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
8.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
4.56 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
2 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
1.0 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
4.25 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
0.99 AS `price__24`)

SELECT
`day__29` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs29`.`day__23` AS `day__29`,    
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`  
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`day__23`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_28`;

### 315	group by rollup with one column
WITH `Sales` AS 	(
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
8.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
4.56 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
2 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
1.0 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
4.25 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
0.99 AS `price__24`)

SELECT
`day__29` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`day__29`,    
`total__28`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs29`.`day__23` AS `day__29`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`    
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`day__23`)    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
NULL AS `day`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`    
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`    
ORDER BY `wrs29`.`day__23` ASC
) AS `set_op_scan_inner`
) AS `aggregate_scan_28`;

### 316	group by rollup with two columns
SELECT
`sku__29` AS `sku`,  
`day__30` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
WITH `Sales` AS 	(  
SELECT    
123 AS `sku__22`,      
1 AS `day__23`,      
9.99 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
123 AS `sku__22`,      
1 AS `day__23`,      
8.99 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
456 AS `sku__22`,      
1 AS `day__23`,      
4.56 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
123 AS `sku__22`,      
2 AS `day__23`,      
9.99 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
789 AS `sku__22`,      
3 AS `day__23`,      
1.0 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
456 AS `sku__22`,      
3 AS `day__23`,      
4.25 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
789 AS `sku__22`,      
3 AS `day__23`,      
0.99 AS `price__24`  )
  
SELECT  
`sku__29`,    
`day__30`,    
`total__28`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`sku__29`,      
`day__30`,      
`total__28`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`wrs29`.`sku__22` AS `sku__29`,        
`wrs29`.`day__23` AS `day__30`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`      
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`sku__22`), zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`day__23`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
`wrs29`.`sku__22` AS `sku__29`,        
NULL AS `day`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`      
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`sku__22`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
NULL AS `sku`,        
NULL AS `day`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`      
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`      
ORDER BY `wrs29`.`sku__22` ASC, `wrs29`.`day__23` ASC
) AS `set_op_scan_inner`
) AS `aggregate_scan_28`  
ORDER BY `sku__29` ASC, `day__30` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 317	group by having

UNION ALL

false AS `y__8`
) AS `set_op_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `x__7` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### 322	inner join with using
WITH `Roster` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'604164616d73' AS `LastName__11`,    
50 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6042756368616e616e' AS `LastName__11`,    
52 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60436f6f6c69646765' AS `LastName__11`,    
52 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604461766973' AS `LastName__11`,    
51 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60456973656e686f776572' AS `LastName__11`,    
77 AS `SchoolID__12`)
, 
`TeamMascot` AS 	(
SELECT  
50 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604a616775617273' AS `Mascot__22`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
51 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604b6e6967687473' AS `Mascot__22`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
52 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604c616b657273' AS `Mascot__22`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
53 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604d757374616e6773' AS `Mascot__22`)

SELECT
`SchoolID__24` AS `SchoolID`,  
`LastName__23` AS `LastName`,  
`Mascot__26` AS `Mascot`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs37`.`LastName__11` AS `LastName__23`,    
`wrs37`.`SchoolID__12` AS `SchoolID__24`  
FROM `Roster` AS `wrs37`
) AS `with_ref_scan_37` INNER JOIN (
SELECT  
`wrs38`.`SchoolID__21` AS `SchoolID__25`,    
`wrs38`.`Mascot__22` AS `Mascot__26`  
FROM `TeamMascot` AS `wrs38`
) AS `with_ref_scan_38` ON `SchoolID__24` = `SchoolID__25`;

### 323	left join
WITH `Roster` AS 	(

### 326	qualify
WITH `Produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'606b616c65' AS `item__19`,    
23 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6062616e616e61' AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'606672756974' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6063616262616765' AS `item__19`,    
9 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606170706c65' AS `item__19`,    
8 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'606672756974' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606c65656b' AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606c657474756365' AS `item__19`,    
10 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`)

SELECT
`item__22` AS `item`,  
`rank__26` AS `rank`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__22`,    
`purchases__23`,    
`category__24`,    
zetasqlite_window_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY `category__24` ORDER BY `purchases__23` DESC GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES) AS `rank__26`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs28`.`item__19` AS `item__22`,      
`wrs28`.`purchases__20` AS `purchases__23`,      
`wrs28`.`category__21` AS `category__24`    
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs28`    
WHERE `wrs28`.`category__21` = X'60766567657461626c65'
) AS `filter_scan_27`  
ORDER BY `category__24` ASC, `purchases__23` DESC
) AS `analytic_scan_26`
WHERE `rank__26` <= 3;

### 327	qualify without group by / where / having
WITH `toks` AS 	(
SELECT  
1 AS `x__3`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
2 AS `x__3`)

SELECT
`x__4` AS `x`
FROM (
SELECT  
`x__4`,    
zetasqlite_window_max(`x__4`) OVER (PARTITION BY `x__4` ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `$analytic1__6`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs15`.`x__3` AS `x__4`    
FROM `toks` AS `wrs15`
) AS `with_ref_scan_15`  
ORDER BY `x__4` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_14`
WHERE `$analytic1__6` > 1;

### 328	qualify group
WITH `produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'606b616c65' AS `item__1`,    
23 AS `purchases__2`)

SELECT
`item__6` AS `item`,  
`$agg1__5` AS `$col2`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__6`,    
`$agg1__5`,    
zetasqlite_window_row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY `item__6` ORDER BY `item__6` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `$analytic1__7`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs11`.`item__1` AS `item__6`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs11`.`purchases__2`) AS `$agg1__5`    
FROM `produce` AS `wrs11`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs11`.`item__1`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_10`  
ORDER BY `item__6` ASC, `item__6` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_9`
WHERE `$analytic1__7` = 1;

FROM `toks` AS `wrs14`;

### 360	contains_substr for table all rows
WITH `Recipes` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'60426c756562657272792070616e63616b6573' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'604567672073616c61642073616e6477696368' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60506f7461746f2064756d706c696e6773' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60506f7461746f2070616e63616b6573' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'60546f6173746564206368656573652073616e6477696368' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'6042656566207374726f67616e6f6666' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6048616d20736372616d626c65' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'60537465616b2061766f6361646f2073616c6164' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60546f6d61746f207061737461' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6041766f6361646f20746f617374' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'60546f6d61746f20736f7570' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60426c756562657272792073616c6d6f6e' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60436f726e656420626565662068617368' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'604c656e74696c20706f7461746f20736f7570' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60476c617a65642068616d' AS `Dinner__18`)

SELECT
`wrs23`.`Breakfast__16` AS `Breakfast`,  
`wrs23`.`Lunch__17` AS `Lunch`,  
`wrs23`.`Dinner__18` AS `Dinner`
FROM `Recipes` AS `wrs23`
WHERE zetasqlite_contains_substr(zetasqlite_make_struct(X'60427265616b66617374', `wrs23`.`Breakfast__16`, X'604c756e6368', `wrs23`.`Lunch__17`, X'6044696e6e6572', `wrs23`.`Dinner__18`), X'60746f617374');

X'604f6f446444644c6c694e6e' AS `expected__2`,

### 454	PIVOT
WITH `produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
51 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605131' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
23 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605132' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
45 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605133' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
3 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605134' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
70 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605131' AS `quarter__39`,    
2021 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
85 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605132' AS `quarter__39`,    
2021 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604170706c65' AS `product__37`,    
77 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605131' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604170706c65' AS `product__37`,    
0 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605132' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604170706c65' AS `product__37`,    
1 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605131' AS `quarter__39`,    
2021 AS `year__40`)

SELECT
`product__46` AS `product`,  
`year__47` AS `year`,  
`Q1__48` AS `Q1`,  
`Q2__49` AS `Q2`,  
`Q3__50` AS `Q3`,  
`Q4__51` AS `Q4`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs36`.`product__37` AS `product__46`,    
`wrs36`.`year__40` AS `year__47`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, X'605131') THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__57`)) AS `Q1__48`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, X'605132') THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__61`)) AS `Q2__49`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, X'605133') THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__65`)) AS `Q3__50`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, X'605134') THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__69`)) AS `Q4__51`  
FROM `produce` AS `wrs36`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs36`.`product__37`), zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs36`.`year__40`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_34`;

### 455	UNPIVOT
WITH `Produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__11`,    
51 AS `Q1__12`,    
23 AS `Q2__13`,    
45 AS `Q3__14`,    
3 AS `Q4__15`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604170706c65' AS `product__11`,    
77 AS `Q1__12`,    
0 AS `Q2__13`,    
25 AS `Q3__14`,    
2 AS `Q4__15`)

SELECT
`product__23` AS `product`,  
`sales__21` AS `sales`,  
`quarter__22` AS `quarter`
FROM (
SELECT  
`with_ref_scan_16`.`product__16` AS `product__23`,    
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_15`.`value`, 0) AS `sales__21`,    
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_15`.`value`, 1) AS `quarter__22`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs16`.`product__11` AS `product__16`,      
`wrs16`.`Q1__12` AS `Q1__17`,      
`wrs16`.`Q2__13` AS `Q2__18`,      
`wrs16`.`Q3__14` AS `Q3__19`,      
`wrs16`.`Q4__15` AS `Q4__20`    
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs16`
) AS `with_ref_scan_16` CROSS JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(zetasqlite_make_array(zetasqlite_make_struct(X'6073616c6573', `Q1__17`, X'6071756172746572', X'605131'), zetasqlite_make_struct(X'6073616c6573', `Q2__18`, X'6071756172746572', X'605132'), zetasqlite_make_struct(X'6073616c6573', `Q3__19`, X'6071756172746572', X'605133'), zetasqlite_make_struct(X'6073616c6573', `Q4__20`, X'6071756172746572', X'605134'))) AS `$array_15`  
WHERE zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_15`.`value`, 0)))
) AS `project_scan_13`;

### 610	interval operator

FROM zetasqlite_unnest(zetasqlite_make_array(zetasqlite_interval(1, X'60444159'), zetasqlite_interval(-1, X'60444159'), zetasqlite_interval(2, X'6059454152'), X'0d0d312d3220332031383a313a3535')) AS `$array_4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### 700	subquery with
WITH `tmp` AS 	(
WITH `A` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `id__1`  )
  
SELECT

FROM `A` AS `wrs12`)

### 701	nested with
WITH `output` AS 	(
WITH `sub` AS 	(  
SELECT    
`$array_8`.`value` AS `val__1`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_8`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs11`.`val__1` AS `val__2`  
FROM `sub` AS `wrs11`  
WHERE `wrs11`.`val__1` > 1)

SELECT
`wrs13`.`val__2` AS `val`
FROM `output` AS `wrs13`;

### 702	join nested with

`id__1` AS `id`,  
`id__3` AS `id`
FROM (
SELECT  
1 AS `id__1`
) AS `project_scan_5` LEFT JOIN (
WITH `tmp` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `id__2`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs12`.`id__2` AS `id__3`  
FROM `tmp` AS `wrs12`
) AS `with_scan_7` ON `id__1` = `id__3`;

### 703	nested with 2
WITH `tmp` AS 	(
WITH `A` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `id__1`  )
,   
`B` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'6068656c6c6f' AS `name__2`  )

`id__3`,    
`name__4`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs16`.`id__1` AS `id__3`    
FROM `A` AS `wrs16`
) AS `with_ref_scan_16` INNER JOIN (
SELECT    
`wrs17`.`name__2` AS `name__4`    
FROM `B` AS `wrs17`
) AS `with_ref_scan_17`)

SELECT
`wrs19`.`id__3` AS `id`,  
`wrs19`.`name__4` AS `name`
FROM `tmp` AS `wrs19`;

### 704	net_host

### 721	limit offset test
CREATE TABLE `IconNames` AS SELECT
`FirstName__5` AS `FirstName`,  
`LastName__6` AS `LastName`
FROM (
SELECT  
X'604b796c6965' AS `FirstName__5`,    
X'604d696e6f677565' AS `LastName__6`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60526f62796e' AS `FirstName__5`,    
null AS `LastName__6`
) AS `set_op_scan_4`;
INSERT INTO `IconNames`
 (`FirstName`, `LastName`) 
VALUES 
(X'60426a6f726b',null);
SELECT
`FirstName__1` AS `FirstName`,  
`LastName__2` AS `LastName`
FROM (
SELECT  
`FirstName__1`,    
`LastName__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`FirstName` AS `FirstName__1`,      
`LastName` AS `LastName__2`    
FROM `IconNames`
) AS `table_scan_5`  
ORDER BY `FirstName__1` ASC  
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
) AS `limit_scan_3`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `IconNames`;

SELECT

### 723	multiple statements with positional params

? AS `c1`;
SELECT
`$col1__2` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_multiply(zetasqlite_multiply(`c1`, ?), ?) AS `$col1__2`  
FROM `t1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `t1`;

### 726	merge two tables with empty source
CREATE TABLE `target` (`id` INT,`name` TEXT) ;
CREATE TABLE `source` (`id` INT,`name` TEXT) ;
CREATE TABLE `zetasqlite_merged_table` AS SELECT DISTINCT
*
FROM (
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,    
`name__4` AS `merged_source_name`,    
`id__1` AS `merged_target_id`,    
`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__3`,      
`name` AS `name__4`    
FROM `source` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`name` AS `name__2`    
FROM `target` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` ON `id__1` = `id__3`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,    
`name__4` AS `merged_source_name`,    
`id__1` AS `merged_target_id`,    
`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`name` AS `name__2`    
FROM `target` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__3`,      
`name` AS `name__4`    
FROM `source` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` ON `id__1` = `id__3`
) AS `merged_union`;
UPDATE `target` SET `id`= `merged_source_id`,`name`= `merged_source_name` FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_id` = `id` AND `merged_target_id` = `id`;
INSERT INTO `target` (`id`,`name`) SELECT `id__3` AS `id`,`name__4` AS `name` FROM (
SELECT  
`id` AS `id__3`,    
`name` AS `name__4`  
FROM `source` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_id` = `id__3` AND `merged_target_id` IS NOT NULL);
DROP TABLE zetasqlite_merged_table;
SELECT
`id`,  
`name`
FROM `target`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `target`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `source`;

### 729	merge two tables where source table is evaluated using a SELECT expression
CREATE TABLE `target` (`id` INT,`name` TEXT) ;
CREATE TABLE `source` (`id` INT,`name` TEXT) ;
INSERT INTO `source`
 (`id`, `name`) 
VALUES 
(1,X'6074657374');
INSERT INTO `source`
 (`id`, `name`) 
VALUES 
(2,X'607465737432');
CREATE TABLE `zetasqlite_merged_table` AS SELECT DISTINCT
*
FROM (
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,    
`name__4` AS `merged_source_name`,    
`id__1` AS `merged_target_id`,    
`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__3`,      
`name` AS `name__4`    
FROM `source`
) AS `project_scan_4` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`name` AS `name__2`    
FROM `target` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` ON `id__1` = `id__3`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,    
`name__4` AS `merged_source_name`,    
`id__1` AS `merged_target_id`,    
`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`name` AS `name__2`    
FROM `target` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__3`,      
`name` AS `name__4`    
FROM `source`
) AS `project_scan_4` ON `id__1` = `id__3`
) AS `merged_union`;
UPDATE `target` SET `id`= `merged_source_id`,`name`= `merged_source_name` FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_id` = `id` AND `merged_target_id` = `id`;
INSERT INTO `target` (`id`,`name`) SELECT `id__3` AS `id`,`name__4` AS `name` FROM (
SELECT  
`id` AS `id__3`,    
`name` AS `name__4`  
FROM `source`
) AS `project_scan_4` WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_id` = `id__3` AND `merged_target_id` IS NOT NULL);
DROP TABLE zetasqlite_merged_table;
SELECT
`id`,  
`name`
FROM `target`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `target`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `source`;

### 730	merge two tables deleting matched rows
CREATE TABLE `target` (`id` INT,`name` TEXT) ;
CREATE TABLE `source` (`id` INT,`name` TEXT) ;
INSERT INTO `target`
 (`id`, `name`) 
VALUES 
(1,X'6074657374');
INSERT INTO `target`
 (`id`, `name`) 
VALUES 
(2,X'607465737432');
INSERT INTO `source`
 (`id`, `name`) 
VALUES 
(1,X'6074657374');
CREATE TABLE `zetasqlite_merged_table` AS SELECT DISTINCT
*
FROM (
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,    
`name__4` AS `merged_source_name`,    
`id__1` AS `merged_target_id`,    
`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__3`,      
`name` AS `name__4`    
FROM `source`
) AS `project_scan_4` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`name` AS `name__2`    
FROM `target` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` ON `id__1` = `id__3`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,    
`name__4` AS `merged_source_name`,    
`id__1` AS `merged_target_id`,    
`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`name` AS `name__2`    
FROM `target` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__3`,      
`name` AS `name__4`    
FROM `source`
) AS `project_scan_4` ON `id__1` = `id__3`
) AS `merged_union`;
DELETE FROM `target` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT `merged_source_id`, `merged_target_id` FROM `zetasqlite_merged_table` WHERE `merged_source_id` = `id` AND `merged_target_id` = `id`);
DROP TABLE zetasqlite_merged_table;
SELECT
`id`,  
`name`
FROM `target`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `target`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `source`;

### 735	with ref scan maps column aliases correctly
CREATE TABLE `events` (`ID` TEXT,`DT` TEXT) ;
WITH `events_cte` AS 	(
SELECT  
`ID` AS `ID__1`,    
zetasqlite_extract_date(zetasqlite_parse_datetime(X'60256d2f25642f25792025483a254d', zetasqlite_nullif(`DT`, X'6030392f31372f32352030303a3030'))) AS `event_date__3`  
FROM `events`)

SELECT
`wrs9`.`ID__1` AS `event_id`,  
`wrs9`.`event_date__3` AS `occurrence_date`
FROM `events_cte` AS `wrs9`
WHERE zetasqlite_equal(zetasqlite_extract(`wrs9`.`event_date__3`, X'6059454152'), 2025);
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `events`;

### 736	ProjectScan with order by column does not output ordered column
SELECT
`name__3` AS `name`,  
`cols__4` AS `cols`
FROM (
WITH `names` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'60666f6f' AS `name__1`,      
X'0e02040178040179' AS `cols__2`  )
  
SELECT  
`name__3`,    
`cols__4`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs9`.`name__1` AS `name__3`,      
`wrs9`.`cols__2` AS `cols__4`,      
zetasqlite_safe_array_at_offset(`wrs9`.`cols__2`, 0) AS `$orderbycol2__5`    
FROM `names` AS `wrs9`
) AS `project_scan_8`  
ORDER BY `name__3` ASC, `$orderbycol2__5` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 737	recursive cte with star expression
SELECT
`n__10` AS `n`,  
`letter__11` AS `letter`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `T0` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `n__1`,      
X'6061' AS `letter__2`  )
,   
`T1` AS 	(  
SELECT    
`wrs11`.`n__1` AS `n__5`,      
`wrs11`.`letter__2` AS `letter__6`    
FROM `T0` AS `wrs11`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
zetasqlite_add(`rrs15`.`n__5`, 1) AS `n__5`,      
`rrs15`.`letter__6`    
FROM `T1` AS `rrs15`    
WHERE `rrs15`.`n__5` < 3  )
  
SELECT  
`n__10`,    
`letter__11`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs17`.`n__5` AS `n__10`,      
`wrs17`.`letter__6` AS `letter__11`    
FROM `T1` AS `wrs17`
) AS `with_ref_scan_17`  
ORDER BY `n__10` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 738	recursive cte with list expression in WHERE
SELECT
`n__9` AS `n`,  
`status__10` AS `status`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `T1` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `n__3`,      
X'607374617274' AS `status__4`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
zetasqlite_add(`rrs12`.`n__3`, 1) AS `n__3`,      
X'6070726f6772657373' AS `status__4`    
FROM `T1` AS `rrs12`    
WHERE zetasqlite_and(`rrs12`.`n__3` < 5, zetasqlite_in(`rrs12`.`status__4`, X'607374617274', X'6070726f6772657373', X'60616374697665'))  )
  
SELECT  
`n__9`,    
`status__10`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs14`.`n__3` AS `n__9`,      
`wrs14`.`status__4` AS `status__10`    
FROM `T1` AS `wrs14`
) AS `with_ref_scan_14`  
ORDER BY `n__9` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 739	recursive cte with unary expression
SELECT
`n__9` AS `n`,  
`active__10` AS `active`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `T1` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `n__3`,      
true AS `active__4`    
UNION ALL

zetasqlite_add(`rrs12`.`n__3`, 1) AS `n__3`,      
NOT (`rrs12`.`active__4`) AS `active__4`    
FROM `T1` AS `rrs12`    
WHERE `rrs12`.`n__3` < 4  )
  
SELECT  
`n__9`,    
`active__10`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs14`.`n__3` AS `n__9`,      
`wrs14`.`active__4` AS `active__10`    
FROM `T1` AS `wrs14`
) AS `with_ref_scan_14`  
ORDER BY `n__9` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 740	recursive cte with complex list and star in join
SELECT
`id__13` AS `id`,  
`name__14` AS `name`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `T0` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `id__1`,      
X'60726f6f74' AS `name__2`  )
,   
`T1` AS 	(  
SELECT    
`wrs11`.`id__1` AS `id__5`,      
`wrs11`.`name__2` AS `name__6`    
FROM `T0` AS `wrs11`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
zetasqlite_add(`recursive_ref_scan_16`.`id__5`, 1) AS `id__5`,      
zetasqlite_concat(`recursive_ref_scan_16`.`name__6`, X'605f6368696c64') AS `name__6`    
FROM `T1` AS `recursive_ref_scan_16` INNER JOIN `T0` AS `project_scan_17` ON `recursive_ref_scan_16`.`id__5` = `project_scan_17`.`id__1`    
WHERE zetasqlite_in(`recursive_ref_scan_16`.`id__5`, 1, 2, 3)  )
  
SELECT  
`id__13`,    
`name__14`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs20`.`id__5` AS `id__13`,      
`wrs20`.`name__6` AS `name__14`    
FROM `T1` AS `wrs20`
) AS `with_ref_scan_20`  
ORDER BY `id__13` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### 741	struct field integration
CREATE TABLE `conductors` (`conductor` TEXT) ;
INSERT INTO `conductors`
 (`conductor`) 
VALUES 
(?);
SELECT
`length__2` AS `length`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`conductor`, 0) AS `length__2`  
FROM `conductors`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### 742	group by struct values basic
SELECT
`person__6` AS `person`,  
`count__5` AS `count`
FROM (
SELECT  
`person__6`,    
`count__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`person__4` AS `person__6`,      
zetasqlite_count_star() AS `count__5`    
FROM (
SELECT      
X'0f02046e616d650405416c69636503616765011e00000000000000' AS `person__4`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0f02046e616d650405416c69636503616765011e00000000000000' AS `person__4`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0f02046e616d650403426f6203616765011900000000000000' AS `person__4`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`person__4`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `count__5` DESC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### 743	group by struct values with aggregation
SELECT
`person__12` AS `person`,  
`total__11` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`person__12`,    
`total__11`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`person__9` AS `person__12`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`amount__10`) AS `total__11`    
FROM (
SELECT      
X'0f02046e616d650405416c6963650464657074040553616c6573' AS `person__9`,        
100 AS `amount__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0f02046e616d650405416c6963650464657074040553616c6573' AS `person__9`,        
200 AS `amount__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0f02046e616d650403426f620464657074040b456e67696e656572696e67' AS `person__9`,        
150 AS `amount__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0f02046e616d650403426f620464657074040b456e67696e656572696e67' AS `person__9`,        
250 AS `amount__10`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`person__9`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `total__11` DESC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### 747	group by array of structs

FROM (

`items__10`,    
`sum_total__9`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`items__7` AS `items__10`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`total__8`) AS `sum_total__9`    
FROM (
SELECT      
X'0e020f02046e616d6504056974656d31057072696365010a000000000000000f02046e616d6504056974656d32057072696365011400000000000000' AS `items__7`,        
100 AS `total__8`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0e020f02046e616d6504056974656d31057072696365010a000000000000000f02046e616d6504056974656d32057072696365011400000000000000' AS `items__7`,        
200 AS `total__8`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0e010f02046e616d6504056974656d33057072696365011e00000000000000' AS `items__7`,        
150 AS `total__8`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`items__7`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`

) AS `order_by_scan_3`;
